mapper.select: SELECT lr.id AS id, lr.formatted_address AS formattedAddress, lr.city AS city, lr.longitude, lr.latitude, lr.province AS province, lr.district AS district, lr.name AS name, lr.description AS description, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT li.image_url) AS imageUrls FROM location_record lr LEFT JOIN location_image li ON lr.id = li.location_id GROUP BY lr.id, lr.formatted_address, lr.city, lr.province, lr.district, lr.name, lr.description ORDER BY lr.id DESC
